description: Core window permissions. All intelligence lives server-side; the shell only needs its own two settings commands (which are always allowed) plus basic window control. allow-start-dragging is NOT part of core:window:default — without it the data-tauri-drag-region strip silently no-ops (hidden titlebar = unmovable window). opener:allow-open-url MUST carry an explicit url scope — the bare permission enables the open_url command with an EMPTY allow-list, so the plugin rejects every URL with ForbiddenUrl (silent-fail). We scope it to http/https ONLY, matching the http(s)-only guard in src/lib/opener.ts — mailto/tel/file/custom schemes are never handed to the OS shell from email content.
